title: Explicit Jordan and signed-Jordan types of the two generalized complex type-AIII Steinberg maps
author: Fresse, Lucas; Nishiyama, Kyo
work: On generalized Steinberg theory for type AIII
difficulty_reason: The author computes the two projections of each conormal fiber by block-matrix constraints, reduces generic kernels to explicitly extended partial permutations, and applies RSK Jordan types to determine every even and odd signed column count. The full new nilpotent block-kernel calculations are retained, distinct from orbit closure classification.
